QF.id: AIFM CIII Governance and Due Diligence_23

question.text: The Compliance Test Report (CTR) for AIFs is filed:

answer.text: At the end of every financial year by the Investment Manager, furnishing details of compliance with AIF Regulations and circulars (submitted within 30 days of financial-year end to the Sponsor and Trustee in the case of a trust)

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI has prescribed the Compliance Test Report (CTR) to be prepared/submitted by the Investment Manager at the end of every financial year, furnishing details of compliance with AIF Regulations and circulars. For an AIF set up as a trust, the CTR is submitted within 30 days from the financial-year end to the Sponsor and Trustee. The Trap: The CTR is not filed weekly to the Trustee, only on winding up, or quarterly to investors; those frequencies and recipients are not prescribed. Note: Violations, if any, observed by the Sponsor or Trustee on review of the CTR are reported by them to SEBI.
